Maybe it's just Déjà Vu?|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 15 ([[Korblox Temple]], Mega & Impossible)}} }} ==Description== The '''Korblox Necromancer''', internally referred to as '''Frost Necromancer''', is an enemy that appears in [[The Hunt: Mega Edition Event]], but only the Impossible difficulty of it. It has a high amount of health but is rather slow. It has one ability, ''Forbidden Arts'', where it summons four random enemies. These can be the [[Korblox Undead (The Hunt: Mega Edition)|Korblox Undead]] with a 75% chance and [[Korblox Warrior (The Hunt: Mega Edition)|Korblox Warrior]] with a 25% chance. Each spawn has a 0.4 second delay between each other and each spawn spawns with a random attribute. This can be [[Nimble]] with 35% chance and [[Bloated]] with a 65% chance. ==Logbook Description== "''Frost Necromancers are artists, rejuvenating life into the corpses of the fallen and employing them to do their bidding. With staffs filled with energized ice, they willfully control their minions and grant them unique modifiers. Though shunned by the Frost Realm as tainted beings, Frost Necromancers remain beloved by the Frost Spirit to raise the dead.''" ==Appearance== The '''Korblox Necromancer''' is a floating, grey skeleton which wears purple robes. Its torso is black. On its back, it carries multiple skeletal parts, which are attached to it through chains wrapped around its torso. It wields a grey staff which has a lantern attached to it. This lantern contains energized ice, which allows them to summon and control its summoned enemies. ==Mutation== {| class="tds-table align-center mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" style="width: 300px; margin: 0 auto" ! colspan="2" |Mutation |- !Percentage !Increase |- |10% |3,000 |- !Wave !Health |- |16 |33,000 |- |17 |36,000 |- |18 |39,000 |- |19 |42,000 |- |20 |45,000 |} ==Event Strategy== *High DPS towers, like the [[Ranger]], [[Minigunner]], [[Pursuit]] or [[Golden Minigunner]] can be useful against this. **The [[Commander]] and [[DJ Booth]] can also be useful at boosting the statistics of these towers. *Splash damage towers like the [[Mortar]], [[Rocketeer]] or [[Trapper]] can be used to deal with the '''Korblox Necromancer''' itself and the hordes of enemies it summons. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} FrostNecromancerFloat.gif|Walking animation (12 March 2025 – 3 December 2025) FrostNecromancerSummon.gif|''Forbidden Arts'' animation (12 December 2025 – 3 December 2025) FrostNecromancerDeath.gif|Unused death animation {{GalleryHeader|Converted Variants}} DefHacker1KorbloxNecromancer.png|Green variant, current version (11 June 2025 – 3 December 2025) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseKorbloxNecromancer.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – 3 December 2025) {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} FrostNecromancerIconIG.png|'''Korblox Necromancer''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Korblox Necromancer''' reuses the same model and animations as the [[Frost Necromancer]] in the [[Operation I.C.E Event]]. **This is pointed out by the [[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] in-game, mentioning how it has seen that enemy somewhere before. **Additionally, the '''Korblox Necromancer''' still uses '''Frost Necromancer''' as its internal name. This means that for example, when its [[Logbooks|Logbook]] is picked up, it will refer to it as the ''Frost Necromancer'', not ''Korblox Necromancer''. ==Update History== *'''12 March 2025''' - [[v1.57.0]] **'''Korblox Necromancer''' added as an enemy to the [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode replacing the [[Frost Necromancer]]. *'''14 March 2025''' - [[v1.57.0|v1.57.8a]] **'''Korblox Necromancer''' added to [[Korblox Temple]] Impossible difficulty. *'''22 March 2025''' - [[v1.57.0|v1.57.11a]] **Now appears in [[Korblox Temple]] Mega difficulty. ***Has 25,000 health in Mega difficulty. *'''24 March 2025''' - [[v1.57.0|v1.57.12a]] **No longer appears in [[Korblox Temple]] Mega difficulty. *'''24 March 2025''' - [[v1.57.0|v1.57.12b]] **'''Korblox Necromancer''' removed from the main game, now appears exclusively in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. *'''3 December 2025''' - [[v1.82.0]] **'''Korblox Necromancer''' removed and replaced by the [[Frost Necromancer]]. ==Notes== {{HuntMega|[[Fallen Necromancer]]|Wave 9|Korblox Necromancer|Wave 15 (Impossible)|[[Fallen Honor Guard]]|Wave 18 (Mega & Impossible)}} {{ZombieNavBox}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:Korblox Necromancer}}
